item.title: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded: I got this excellent art piece about SCP-5682. I'm a huge fan of the use of color in the work and how much the fire and beam of light stand out from the rest. It really captures the spirit of that final event very well, and I think this is super cool. Thank you!

item.title: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded: I requested art of any character from my works, and got a wonderfully dark rendition of O5-10 referencing his source tale Setting Sun. Fantastic work.

item.title: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
So, uh… my original request was admittedly ambitious, which is part of why I offered an easier option. Additionally, even if the gifter went with the original request… I expected at most a tale with the concept in the background.

However, what I actually got is so ambitious, so beyond what I could have ever asked for that it not only made me cackle with glee, it made me actually cry from sheer gratitude.

I… I seriously cannot thank you enough. What you've provided is such an extraordinarily compelling setup that I hope it inspires other authors to write their own works in this canon.

Again, thank you with every fiber of my being. <3

item.title: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
I received this WONDERFUL SCP involving 5993.

I am floored at the quality of this gift and I love it to absolute bits. This is just spectacular in every which way possible. It's something I've always wanted to do with the bees and it was executed with the upmost quality. Thank you gifter, this is amazing <3.

item.title: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded: I received this lovely Site-Dossier. I would have probably never come around to making one, so this is a welcome addition. Looking forward to adding more!

item.title: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded: I received this wonderful little entry complete with bookend images! It's very WL, just what I asked for - as the title implies, it's all about Wonder, what inspires it, what shapes it, what defines it. I love it, and I'll be glad to see this posted to the Library when I figure out who wrote it and thank the everloving shit out of them!

item.title: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
This year I received a lovely Ancient Egyptian wall painting for the Team Bird pigeons who worship Thoth!

And here it is: http://scp-sandbox-3.wikidot.com/secret:thing

It's adorable! I've yet to sit down and discern what the heiroglyphs mean. But I really like it! Thank you!

item.title: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
I got a wonderful tale featuring what is admittedly one of my most underdeveloped characters, Albert "Phineas" Frostman, the co-founder of Anderson Robotics.

To whoever my gifter is I do not have the words to describe how wonderful this tale is. It is amazing and I fully consider it canon to Those Twisted Pines and the Anderson Robotics tale arc. I would love to see it posted on the site so I might upvote it properly.

Thank you. Thank you so much!

(Also, I love the use of the song lyrics. A++)
